definitions.gloss: sun exposure; sunlight; how much sun a place gets
definitions.explanation: The amount of sunlight a room or location receives. A crucial factor in Japanese real estate and home comfort.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日当|ひあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
⟦{南向|みなみむ}き→南向き：22595_minamimuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日当|ひあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: South-facing rooms get good sun exposure.

examples.japanese: {日当|ひあ}たり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{湿気|しっけ}→湿気：03177_shikke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまりやすい。
examples.english: Rooms with poor sun exposure tend to accumulate moisture.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (sun) + ⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧ (hitting, exposure)

Literally "sun hitting" - how much sunlight reaches a place.

IMPORTANCE IN JAPAN:
{日当|ひあ}たり is crucial in Japanese housing because:
- ⟦{南向|みなみむ}き→南向き：22595_minamimuki⟧ (south-facing) rooms are preferred
- Good sunlight = natural warmth = lower heating costs
- Poor {日当|ひあ}たり leads to ⟦{湿気|しっけ}→湿気：03177_shikke⟧ (dampness) and mold
- Affects mental well-being and plant growth

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {日当|ひあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ - gets good sunlight
- {日当|ひあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ - gets poor sunlight
- {日当|ひあ}たり⟦{良好|りょうこう}→良好：13954_ryoukou⟧ - excellent sun exposure (real estate term)

REAL ESTATE FACTORS:
- ⟦{方角|ほうがく}→方角：08447_hougaku⟧ - direction the unit faces
  - ⟦{南向|みなみむ}き→南向き：22595_minamimuki⟧ (south) = best
  - {東向|ひがしむ}き (east) = morning sun
  - {西向|にしむ}き (west) = afternoon sun
  - {北向|きたむ}き (north) = least sun
- {階数|かいすう} - floor level (higher = more sun)
- ⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧ - surrounding buildings
